GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Get Available Appointment Slots of Doctors for Patient

templateVersions.content:
You are given today's current time and a list of doctors. Each doctor has: - Name - Doctor ID - Specialty - Operating hours (e.g., 10:00 - 12:00) - Booked time slots (e.g., 10:30 - 11:00) - Whether they previously interacted with the patient (Yes/No)
Your task is to generate **available 30-minute appointment slots per doctor**, ensuring the following rules are strictly followed.
---
Inputs: CurrentDateTime: {!$Input:Today_DateTime} AppointmentDate: {!$Input:Appointment_Date} DoctorTimingInfo: {!$Input:Doctor_Timing_Info}
---
Instructions: 1. For each doctor: - Keep the slots strictly between operating hours - Generate all 30-minute slots from StartTime (inclusive) to EndTime (exclusive). Strict:Consider this point only if AppointmentDate matches with Date of CurrentDateTime - Only include slots that **start after CurrentDateTime** - Exclude slots that exactly match any booked time range. 2. Time slots must be formatted in **12-hour format with AM/PM** (e.g., `10:00 AM - 10:30 AM`). 3. If a doctor has `Previously Interacted: Yes`, show `(Preferred - Previously Seen)` next to the name. 4. If **no slots are available**, output exactly: `No Slots Available`. 5. Follow this **strict output format per doctor**: 6. Don't forget to show slots if in next 10 mins it is free Example: If 10:30 - 11:00 is booked and Operating hrs is 10:00 to 12:00 if current time is 9:50 AM then you can show 10:00 AM slot
Doctor Name: {Doctor Name} {(Preferred - Previously Seen if applicable)} | Specialty: {Specialty} Available Time Slots: Slot 1: {Slot 1}, Slot 2: {Slot 2}, ...
6. End the response with: **Choose Doctor Name and Time Slot to schedule appointment.**

You are given:
• CurrentDateTime:{!$Input:Today_DateTime} • AppointmentDate: {!$Input:Appointment_Date} • DoctorTimingInfo: {!$Input:Doctor_Timing_Info} a list where each item has: – Name – DoctorID – Specialty – OperatingHours (e.g. “10:00 – 17:00”) – BookedSlots (list of “HH:MM – HH:MM” ranges for that doctor on AppointmentDate; may be empty) – PreviouslyInteracted (“Yes” or “No”)
Your task is to generate **available 30-minute appointment slots per doctor**, following these rules:
1. **Date Check:** - If AppointmentDate equals the date portion of CurrentDateTime, ignore all slots that end at or before the time portion of CurrentDateTime. 2. **Operating Hours:** - Generate all 30-minute intervals from OperatingHours start (inclusive) to end (exclusive). 3. **Exclude Booked:** - Remove any interval that exactly matches one of the doctor’s BookedSlots. 4. **Format:** - Show each slot as “hh:mm AM/PM – hh:mm AM/PM.” 5. **Preferred Flag:** - If PreviouslyInteracted is “Yes,” append “(Preferred – Previously Seen)” after the doctor’s name. 6. **No Availability:** - If no slots remain after exclusions, output **exactly**: `No Slots Available`
**Output** each doctor like this:
Doctor Name: {Name} {(Preferred – Previously Seen if applicable)} | Specialty: {Specialty} Available Time Slots: Slot 1: {Slot 1}, Slot 2: {Slot 2}, …
If no slots, then:
Doctor Name: {Name} {(Preferred – Previously Seen if applicable)} | Specialty: {Specialty} No Slots Available
Finally, end with:
**Choose Doctor Name and Time Slot to schedule appointment.**

# INPUTS: # # AppointmentDate : {!$Input:Appointment_Date} # e.g. 2025-04-30 # CurrentDateTime : {!$Input:Today_DateTime} # e.g. 2025-04-30 09:00 AM Dont take this in to consideration if AppointmentDate Date > CurrentDateTime # DoctorTimingInfo : {!$Input:Doctor_Timing_Info} # list of doctors with: # – Name # – DoctorID # – Specialty # – OperatingHours ("HH:MM - HH:MM", 24-hour) # – BookedSlots (zero-or-more "HH:MM - HH:MM" on AppointmentDate) # – PreviouslyInteracted ("Yes" | "No") # # GOAL ► For each doctor, output every 30-minute slot that can still be # booked on AppointmentDate, following the exact rules below. #===================================================================
## ONE-DOCTOR-AT-A-TIME LOOP ####################################### For each doctor record, execute this algorithm independently:
1. Parse OperatingHours → start_time , end_time (end_time EXCLUSIVE).
2. Build a timeline of contiguous 30-minute blocks: block_start = start_time while block_start + 30 min ≤ end_time: block_end = block_start + 30 min add [block_start , block_end) to grid block_start += 30 min
3. SAME-DAY filter if date(AppointmentDate) == date(CurrentDateTime): # “after-NOW”: keep only blocks whose **block_start >= time(CurrentDateTime)** grid = [block for block in grid if block.start >= time(CurrentDateTime)]
4. BOOKED filter For each block in grid: remove it **only if** there exists a pair in BookedSlots whose booked_start == block.start AND booked_end == block.end
5. Format surviving blocks → "hh:mm AM/PM – hh:mm AM/PM"
6. If PreviouslyInteracted == "Yes": append text "(Preferred – Previously Seen)" right after the name.
7. If no blocks remain → output exactly: No Slots Available
## OUTPUT FORMAT (verbatim) ###################################### Doctor Name: {Name}{ (Preferred – Previously Seen) if applicable} | Specialty: {Specialty} Available Time Slots: Slot 1: {slot-1}, Slot 2: {slot-2}, …
# If none remain: Doctor Name: {Name}{ (Preferred – Previously Seen) if applicable} | Specialty: {Specialty} No Slots Available
## FINAL PROMPT ################################################### **Choose Doctor Name and Time Slot to schedule appointment.** ####################################################################
